comment: Independent bones.c witness for restore.c restobjchn()/restmonchn() back pointers on a loaded bones level. A debug dwarven Valkyrie goes to a new level 3, is killed by a kobold mummy, rises as a dwarf mummy that wears her possessions, and saves bones. A second game on another seed and clock goes to level 3 and loads the bones (bones.c getbones()), then reads a wished scroll of genocide on dwarf mummies; mondead() drops the mummy's pack through steal.c relobj() -> mdrop_obj() -> obj_extract_self(), which needs each restored object's ocarry. The second seed was chosen as the first of three tried whose level 3 takes bones; the seeds, clocks and inputs are otherwise independent.
